description:
Welcome to I’d Like to Know — the weekly Bible Q&A.
This week, Pastor Stephen Bohr and the SUMtv panel respond to a viewer from Zambia asking:

💬 “In Deuteronomy 14:26, it mentions 'strong drink' — was this alcoholic beverage really permitted by God in the Old Testament? How should we understand this verse in light of the whole Bible?”

This episode explores the Hebrew meaning of “shekar”, God's character, the consistent biblical warnings against alcohol, and the health principles given to His people.

Whether you're a Seventh-day Adventist or a truth-seeking Christian, this discussion will deepen your understanding of God’s will for His people — in both ancient and modern times.
